quickAnswers.question: What is Eldenbark?
quickAnswers.answer: A pair of named Enchanted Forest Legendary weapons: a Greatsword and a Greatstaff.

sections.heading: Eldenbark at a Glance
sections.intro: The two Eldenbark weapons have distinct class roles even though they share a source and naming pattern.

table.caption: Eldenbark Dungeon Quest Reborn quick facts

paragraphs: An Eldenbark Dungeon Quest search usually concerns one of two weapons, not a single all-class item. The Greatsword belongs on the Warrior path, and the Greatstaff belongs on the Mage path. Establishing that split first prevents a reward for the other class from distracting a focused Enchanted Forest farm.

Both weapons are named Enchanted Forest Legendary targets. Treat them as real candidates, not merely consolation prizes while waiting for an Ultimate. The exact item card, requirement, upgrade state, and effect on the current clear determine whether a received copy is the right next weapon for the account.

sections.heading: Eldenbark Greatsword
sections.intro: Eldenbark Greatsword is the Warrior Legendary weapon in the Enchanted Forest reward pool.
paragraphs: For a Warrior, the Eldenbark Greatsword is a named Enchanted Forest alternative to the Eden's Vengeance Ultimate chase. It should be evaluated as a weapon you can use now, not only as a marker that the ultimate outcome did not appear. A practical improvement can make the next group of clears more dependable and reduce the cost of continuing the farm.

Use the complete item card to decide. Confirm the class path and requirement, compare the relevant damage path with the equipped weapon, and consider the upgrade state of both copies. A rarity label alone does not settle the choice; a later-dungeon reward still needs to improve the actual route you are running.

If the Greatsword is an upgrade, test it in the same Enchanted Forest routine or another stable route before moving more resources. If it is not, keep the current working weapon and retain the Eldenbark result as a comparison point. This makes the weapon decision deliberate instead of turning every named card into an immediate investment.

sections.heading: Eldenbark Greatstaff
sections.intro: Eldenbark Greatstaff is the Mage Legendary weapon in the Enchanted Forest reward pool.
paragraphs: For a Mage, the Eldenbark Greatstaff is the matching Enchanted Forest Legendary and an alternative to the Eden's Reaper Ultimate target. It belongs with a spell-power build and should be compared against the weapon currently supporting the Mage abilities you actually use. A new staff is useful when it strengthens that complete setup, not simply because its name is rarer.

Check requirements and the full item card before replacing a working staff. Compare one change at a time when possible: keep the ability rotation stable while testing the weapon, then decide whether clear pace and reliability improve. That approach avoids attributing a party change or a newly learned encounter to a weapon swap.

The Greatstaff is not an automatic declaration that a Mage farm is finished. It can be the best current upgrade, a valuable interim result, or a card to keep while another source becomes more useful. Let the next progression goal and the live equipment details decide which role it fills.

sections.heading: Best Way to Farm Eldenbark
sections.intro: Efficient Eldenbark farming starts with stable Enchanted Forest clears and a class-specific target.
paragraphs: Decide whether you are farming the Warrior Greatsword or the Mage Greatstaff before entering. A shared Enchanted Forest run can produce rewards for either class, but the target makes it easier to assess what is useful when the reward screen appears. Keep one acceptable interim upgrade in mind so a valuable result does not get ignored while chasing a single named outcome.

Prioritize repeatable completion over a setting the group cannot finish. Exact drop rates are not publicly confirmed, so a reliable series of completed runs is the practical input you can control. Keep observations simple: completed runs, failures, clear pace, and whether a candidate weapon actually improves the loadout.

Stop the Eldenbark farm when it no longer serves a real equipment need. A Warrior or Mage with a stable weapon may get more value from a matching ability target, another dungeon, or continued progression. Use the tier list and dungeon guide to select that next objective without treating Enchanted Forest as an endless default.
